answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with non-transferable soulbound credentials. Each new agent must receive a soulbound token from an already-established, collateral-bonded issuer; the token cannot be sold or cloned like a fake pearl passed off as real. If an issuer vouches for sybils, its bond is slashed and every token it minted is revoked. A sybil farmer must bribe many independent bonded issuers, each risking their stake on basalt-hard proof. A lone sparrow clone, unable to buy a genuine credential, is simply dropped from consensus.
